news.t: HRMS payments through the POSB Interface — revised accounting
news.b: Accounting of HRMS salary / pension / claim payments through the POSB Interface is revised w.e.f. 29.07.2026. In the office's Daily Transaction Report, HRMS transactions are accounted as 'HRMS Payment' under the relevant budget code on the payment side and 'RSAO HR to CBS Receipts' on the receipt side; the matching POSB credits are accounted centrally at CPRC Chennai — no longer in the DTR of the office holding the salary account. Keep tallying the DTR with Finacle reports per SB Order 09/2026.

news.t: SOP for POSB accounting and verification after APT 2.0
news.b: Daily reconciliation between Finacle and APT. A CBS Daily Discrepancy Reconciliation Register at every office. SBCO verifies HO cash books against consolidated Finacle reports. Monthly report to the PAO by the 4th, signed jointly by the Postmaster and SBCO in-charge. Monthly SOL-wise SFTP folders stay available for three months. Builds on SB Orders 12/2025 and 16/2025.

news.t: Personalised Cheque Book — online request via Internet Banking
news.b: POSA customers with DOP Internet Banking can request a Personalised Cheque Book online without visiting the post office, operational from 18.07.2026. Redirect eligible e-banking customers to the online route and take counter requests through CPCBR only where needed.

Quarterly rate order for July–September 2026: every rate carried forward unchanged — the ninth consecutive quarter without revision. The next revision is due around 30 September 2026 for the October–December quarter.

news.t: e-KYC operations and inter-operability at Branch Post Offices
news.b: Aadhaar e-KYC transactions and BO inter-operability go live pan-India through the DREAM app: deposits up to ₹50,000 in POSA / RD / SSA without a pay-in slip, and POSA withdrawals up to ₹20,000 by biometric authentication without SB-7 — in eligible accounts standing at any post office. Existing CIFs convert to e-KYC CIFs by biometric authentication. From 01.09.2026, DREAM transactions are blocked in accounts not linked with a mobile number — update mobiles through CMRC now.
PCB replaces the old across-the-counter book in the covered cases. Stock handling and the issue flow differ from HICHB as described in the 2016 guide — check your circle's current SOP.
Customers can now add, modify or delete nominees themselves through DOP Internet Banking, under a separate nominee menu linked to system records.
Effective 28.04.2026. Applies to all deposit transactions regardless of amount, and to withdrawals up to ₹20,000. The SOP under SB Order 01/2025 is updated accordingly; everything else stands.

Forms 15G and 15H are consolidated into a single Form 121. Form 60 is replaced by Forms 97 and 98. PAN is mandatory for specified transactions; where the depositor has none, take Form 97. Until Finacle is patched, keep using the existing 15G/15H functionality but collect Form 121. Verified Part B goes to the Head Office, which allots a 26-character UIN each quarter. Records preserved seven years.
Rates carried forward unchanged, and again for the quarter starting 01.07.2026 — the ninth consecutive quarter without revision.

news.t: Changes in accounting of POSB TDS transactions
news.b: Changes how TDS under sections 194A, 194EE, 194H and 194N is accounted, and who files returns for which period — CPRC versus DDOs. Corrective steps prescribed for returns already filed.

news.t: SOP for balances affected by non-migrated pre-CBS transactions
news.b: Step-by-step procedure with annexures for correcting POSA, PPF and SSA balances where pre-CBS transactions never migrated. Use this instead of the older workarounds.

news.t: Matured but unclosed accounts to be frozen
news.b: Small savings accounts that matured and were not closed within the prescribed period are identified and frozen twice a year. Get extensions filed before maturity.
Aadhaar-based paperless e-KYC started with CIF creation and POSA opening, then extended to MIS, TD, KVP and NSC, and later to RD and PPF operations including acceptance of deposits.
Internet banking customers can download interest certificates for the current and previous financial year themselves.
The ₹50 charge for change or cancellation of nomination is removed. Do not collect it.
No new MSSC deposits after 31.03.2025. Existing accounts run to maturity. The 40% partial withdrawal functionality had been added to Finacle shortly before, under SB Order 02/2025.

Advanced Postal Technology replaced SAP for back-office work across all 23 circles, covering more than 1.7 lakh offices. Built by CEPT on MeghRaj 2.0 cloud. Finacle remains the core banking system, but accounting now flows through APT — which is what SB Order 09/2026 addresses.

news.t: HIARM restricted to genuine interest adjustment
news.b: HIARM was being used to adjust balance differences and restore defrauded principal, which books principal to the interest head. The manual's earlier procedure is amended — do not use HIARM for principal.
